title: 第7章 明劲第8章 杀人第9章 裂石
content_zh:
“怎么，惜才了？”
与此同时，大堂背后，走出了一位温婉秀丽的女子。
此人正是沈衡的妻子林氏，她看着沈衡看着陆沉的背影，不由好奇地询问道。
沈衡摇了摇头，然后开口说道：“他的悟性颇佳，若是能突破化境层次，说不得还要比姜寒更甚三份。”
“可惜化境之前，悟性远比不上根骨重要。”
林氏也颔首，感慨道：“武道修行，更重资粮和根骨，若是连化境都不能突破，再强的悟性怕也难有大的成就。”
“嗯。”
沈衡点头，又突然道：“老大伤了根基，老二潜力不足，再过两年我的气血就要开始衰败了，这武馆总得要有个人继承衣钵。”
“若是没有姜寒，这陆沉或许还能作为备选之一，但如今……”
沈衡摇了摇头，没有再说下去。
林氏也点了点头，毕竟武馆资材有限，最多也就只能养出一个真正的衣钵传人。
“……”
这天下午，城外树林中。
朔风卷着鹅毛大雪，将整片松林冻成了银装素裹的世界。
枯枝在寒风中发出呜咽，积雪从枝头簌簌坠落。
陆沉赤着上身，身上裹着一层带刺的荆条，身姿在皑皑白雪的映衬下，散发着淡淡白烟。
这荆条长满了尖刺，至少稍微一动都会刺进到肉里，刺出深深的血痕。
但他却始终面不改色，站在一棵古松之下，双目微阖，呼吸悠长而平稳，一招又一招的施展三十六式铁甲功。
每一次施展，他都浑身刺痛，但伤口却又在转瞬恢复如初。
在不断练习中，脚下的积雪，早已被踏出深深的脚印，露出了下面深褐色的冻土。

这是他习武第二十八天，也是他得到铁甲功口诀精要第七天。
经过近一个月的苦练，他的身高猛涨了一截，铁甲功更是进展极大，距离小成之境已然只有最后一步之遥。
“呼——”
陆沉猛地睁开双眼，眸中精光爆射。
只见其他双脚微分，扎了个稳稳的马步，而后双手握拳，缓缓抬起，拳面朝向天空。
“哈！”
一声低喝，如同闷雷在雪地中炸响。
陆沉的双拳骤然发力，带着一股刚猛无俦的劲风，狠狠砸向身前的空气。
“砰！”
空中传来一阵破空声，积雪被震得向四周飞溅。
他并未停歇，双拳如同狂风暴雨般，朝着四面八方轰击而去。
“明劲……明劲……”
他低声嘶吼，双拳越打越快，越打越重。
渐渐地，他的骨骼开始发出细微的“咔咔”声，如同炒豆子一般，从手臂蔓延到肩膀，再到胸膛、脊背……
“筋骨齐鸣！”
“铁甲功小成！”
陆沉低语，双目愈发明亮。
只见他毫不停歇，全力催动铁甲功，周身汹涌气血在这筋骨齐鸣加持之下，向着气血大关叩击而去。
他的眼神越来越亮，呼吸也越来越急促，体内的气血如同奔腾的江河，在经脉中汹涌澎湃，从四面八方凝聚于一点。
他的气血源源不断，无尽的生命力肆无忌惮地挥霍，宛如海浪般一波又一波地叩击气血大关。

一次、两次、三次、接连三次扣关之后，终于——
“喝！”
content_en:
"What, you're just praising your talent?"
At the same time, a gentle and beautiful woman walked out from behind the lobby.
This person was Shen Heng's wife Lin. She looked at Shen Heng and Lu Chen's back and asked curiously.
Shen Heng shook his head, and then said: "His understanding is quite good. If he can break through the level of transformation, he will probably be three times better than Jiang Han."
"It's a pity that before transformation, understanding is far less important than the bones."
Lin also nodded and said with emotion: "Martial arts practice is more important than qualifications and foundation. If you can't even break through the realm of transformation, no matter how strong your understanding is, it will be difficult to achieve great achievements."
"Yeah."
Shen Heng nodded, and suddenly said: "The boss has damaged his foundation, and the second brother has insufficient potential. In two years, my energy and blood will begin to decline. There must be someone in this martial arts school who can inherit the mantle."
"If there were no Jiang Han, Lu Chen might still be one of the alternatives, but now..."
Shen Heng shook his head and said no more.
Mrs. Lin also nodded. After all, the martial arts gym had limited resources, and at most it could only raise a true successor.
"..."
This afternoon, in the woods outside the city.
The shoal wind rolled up heavy snow, freezing the entire pine forest into a world covered with snow.
The dead branches whimpered in the cold wind, and snow fell from the branches.
Lu Chen's upper body was bare and wrapped in a layer of thorny thorns. His figure was exuding a faint white smoke against the backdrop of the white snow.
The thorns were covered with sharp thorns, which would pierce into the flesh if moved at least slightly, leaving deep bloody marks.
But he never changed his expression. He stood under an ancient pine, his eyes were slightly closed, his breathing was long and steady, and he performed the thirty-six iron armor skills one after another.
Every time he used it, he felt pain all over his body, but the wounds healed instantly.
During the continuous practice, deep footprints have been made in the snow under my feet, exposing the dark brown frozen soil below.
This is his twenty-eighth day of practicing martial arts, and it is also the seventh day that he has obtained the essence of the Iron Armor Kung Fu formula.
After nearly a month of hard training, his height has soared, and his iron armor skills have made great progress. He is only one step away from reaching the realm of minor success.
"Huh——"
Lu Chen opened his eyes suddenly, and his eyes were filled with light.
The other two legs were slightly apart, and they took a steady stance. Then they made fists with both hands and slowly raised them, with their fists facing the sky.
"Ha!"
A low cry sounded like muffled thunder exploding in the snow.
Lu Chen's fists suddenly exerted force, and with a strong and powerful wind, they hit the air in front of him.
"Bang!"
There was a burst of sound in the air, and the snow was shaken and splashed around.
He didn't stop, his fists struck in all directions like a violent storm.
"Ming Jin... Ming Jin..."
He roared lowly and punched faster and harder with his fists.
Gradually, his bones began to make a subtle "click" sound, like fried beans, spreading from his arms to his shoulders, to his chest, back...
"The muscles and bones roar together!"
"Iron armor is a success!"
Lu Chen whispered, his eyes getting brighter.
I saw him not stopping, using all his strength to activate the Iron Armor Kung Fu, and the surging Qi and blood all over his body, supported by the sound of muscles and bones, struck towards the Qi and Blood mark.
His eyes became brighter and brighter, and his breathing became faster and faster. The energy and blood in his body were like a rushing river, surging through his meridians, condensing to one point from all directions.
His energy and blood flowed continuously, and his endless vitality was squandered unscrupulously, just like the waves hitting the energy and blood barrier one after another.
After pressing the level once, twice, three times, and three times in a row, finally——
"Drink!"
